JAVARIOUS

Leader of Reverence
☀ Light Front-line carry Shield & strike

A greatsword carry who hits twice as hard while he is untouched — which sounds like a contradiction on the front line until you read the shield. Absorbed damage never reaches HP, so a shielded Javarious is a full-health Javarious. The bubble is not his safety net. It is his win condition.

✦ Dawn Reliquary

His signature moment, and the only skill in his kit that does no damage at all.
  • He plants the blade and takes the light in. Four frames of gathering, then the shield closes around him for the rest of the clip.
  • Heal 20% ATK, shield 30% ATK, three turns. The heal restores the full-health condition; the shield protects it.
  • Cast it at full health on purpose. The heal does nothing there, and that is fine — the shield is what he came for.
  • The bubble on the last five frames is the same art the board draws: frame 0 of the bubble effect, painted gold, at 75% opacity.
Gather · take the light · shielded
How a shield works. It is a pool of absorbed damage with a lifetime, and it sits after mitigation: a ward reduces what arrives, and the shield eats what is left, so the two stack rather than compete. It is spent oldest stack first. Break it with a hit and the bubble bursts; let it run out its duration and it simply fades, because nothing broke it.

✦ The loop

Four pieces that only make sense together.
1
Open at full health. Unbroken Cut and Daybreak Sweep both land for double while his HP bar is untouched — 310% and 280% ATK.
2
Every blow feeds the bubble. On a front hex, 10% of the damage he deals is added to his own shield. The hex that puts him in reach of the enemy is the hex that pays for standing there.
3
The bubble takes the hit, not his HP. While it holds, he is still at full health, so the doubling survives being attacked.
4
The light mends him back. At the start of his turn he draws 5% of whatever shield is still standing back as HP, which is what closes the gap after a hit spills through.

Gathering Dawn

Every blow Javarious lands adds 10% of its damage to his shield. Off the front line it does nothing at all — and neither, in practice, does the rest of him.

Passive · always on

Light Kept In

At the start of his turn he mends 5% of whatever shield is still standing. A bigger bubble is a bigger heal, so the two halves of the kit compound.

That 93.2 is his floor, not his average: it is what he does with the doubling almost never firing. At max level his ATK is around 4,700 against an HP pool near 30,000, so a shield worth 30% ATK is under 5% of one bar — enough to blunt a hit, not enough to hold full health against a whole front line. The turns where it does hold spike well above the number in that table.

✦ Getting him

Temporal Scrolls only. Dark and Light heroes cannot be summoned from Common or Rare scrolls at all. Temporal Scrolls come from chapter-end campaign clears, the monthly quest board, boss stages 15 and up, and every fiftieth floor of the Endless Tower.
